visual.title: The coincidence detector and the two phases
visual.alt: A synapse showing glutamate released onto NMDA and AMPA receptors, with the NMDA channel plugged by magnesium until the membrane depolarises, and the cascade that follows: calcium entry, CaMKII activation, AMPA receptors phosphorylated and inserted, and a larger response to the same input; a contrast between early long-term potentiation, which needs no new protein, and late potentiation, which runs through PKA and CREB to new gene expression; and a curve of hippocampal dependence falling over months, beside the roles of slow-wave and REM sleep in consolidation.
visual.caption: The magnesium plug is why conditioning is selective: glutamate alone does nothing, and only a synapse that was active while the cell was already firing gets strengthened.
visual.beforeHeading: ### NMDA Receptors: The Molecular Coincidence Detectors
